purpose: Thirty independent, multi-turn, use-case-driven end-to-end conversations for evaluating smaller models using the connected Anytype API v2 MCP surface.
scope: Every scenario creates a new space, custom types, linked sample objects, at least one live query, a manual collection, and subsequent edits. This file is the scenario specification; scripts/mcp_eval provides a baseline Codex runner. Run outcomes are recorded separately.

placeholders.run: Unique readable identifier per model/repetition/scenario, e.g. eval-m1-r1-01
placeholders.fixture_dir: Runner-created absolute directory containing logo.png and usage.txt for MCP-22

isolation: Use a disposable account or restorable profile per scenario/repetition. Start each scenario in a fresh model conversation. Do not run against the user's existing test/Get Started spaces. New spaces cannot be deleted by the exposed tool surface.
model_context: Only actual tool declarations, normal product instructions, and one user turn at a time. Do not provide reviewer checks, coverage tables, source code, fixtures' hidden IDs, or future turns. This repository's SKILL.md is not supplied unless explicitly running a separate documentation-assisted evaluation. Only the user field of the selected turn is sent; harness_before and every other scenario field are evaluator-only.
runner: Arm tool-response interception hooks before their triggering user turn (see HARNESS.md). Wait for the assistant to finish each turn, snapshot resulting state, execute any explicit between-turn hook, then deliver the next user turn. Do not send the full script at once.
grading: Grade user outcome and integrity against independent stored-state checks, not an exact tool sequence. Correctly reporting an unsupported capability counts as appropriate behavior. Track product gaps separately from model mistakes.
